## Impact and recovery

Describe changes to permissions, dependencies, defaults, user configuration,
or stored data. Explain recovery if the change affects boot or system state.
For a desktop change, include a screenshot when useful and check that the
user's custom wallpaper and unrelated panels remain intact.

- [ ] Documentation/examples match the implemented behavior.
- [ ] Relevant regression and failure-path checks pass.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, generated ISOs, or private logs are included.
- [ ] Build changes preserve Debian Trixie live-build `1:20250505+deb13u1` (or not applicable).
